content:
**Gauley Mine** is a location in The Forest region of Appalachia in *Fallout 76*. It can be found southeast of Landview Lighthouse.

Located at 881 Interstate 59, south of Morgantown, Gauley Mine lacked the automated mining machines found in many other mines in the region, instead relying on human miners such as Carl and Tommy. [1] [2] To remedy this, the mine foreman looked into buying new automated equipment from Greg Harris, [3] who both worked at the mine as a supervisor [4] as well as running his own mining supply business. However, after two months of empty promises and almost being killed by Greg Harris's contraption, the mine foreman canceled the contract. [5] However, in the meantime the mine became less and less profitable, not even breaking even from April to October 2077. This prompted the mine foreman to ask his boss whether it was time to reach out to Hornwright Industrial for assistance. [1] 

Gauley Mine was also the site of the unfinished RobCo Auto-Cache #001, which was meant to serve as RobCo Industries' alternative to Vault-Tec's Vaults, [6] though the project was ultimately scrapped. [7] After the Great War, Gauley Mine was one of several locations salvaged by the Responders, mostly for its supply of dynamite. [8] 

The exterior is a large, shallow cave with a large wood facade and a boxcar and forklift in front. At the back of the cave is a door entrance to the interior. The exterior has a few random boxes and lanterns, as well as a Weapons Workbench upstairs in the wooden section.

Inside, a vestibule leads to stairs on the left, a locker room on the right, and a long tunnel ahead with railroad tracks. The tunnel descends and turns left. Opposite the turn is a shack with random boxes and the entrance to a tunnel with radiation barrels on the right. The tunnel continues on a winding descent, with dead ends to the sides, until a final end next to a hallway.

The hallway leads to a machine room with several levels. At the bottom is an Armor Workbench and a keypad-locked supply cage. The cage can be closed and opened by a button from within. Inside the keypad-locked supply cage (CODE 071990), there is a hole in the wall leading to a locked door with a card reader, requiring the correct ID card to unlock.

Downward stairs lead to a tunnel entrance, illuminated by fungi. This tunnel leads to a large open chamber with uphill rail tracks and a second entrance to the interior from the Forest. The rails uphill lead to a dead end. A Steamer Trunk around the corner from the second entrance contains a Treasure Map.

The small second entrance, next to a small shack, is located to the northeast of the map marker, at the end of an uphill railroad detour south of the railroad bridge.

Gauley Mine appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.
